what_this_is: Every word do-work/rules-and-verdicts.mjs says: the ids of the findings it makes itself, the words of each finding, and the refusals. {name} is filled from the finding. A rule row's own words (says, suggest) come from the row, never from here.
partly: Partly is not shippable as is: held at review, failed at final.
basis_gone: Basis gone: every stance this row came from was taken back, so it only holds.
part_unjudged: They have not judged this {kind} ({value}): it waits for them.
held: Held, not failed: the unit's facts are ones this row only holds on (its held_when), and no stance of theirs names this; a person decides.
held_why: held_when: the row's finding only holds on a unit with these facts
reading_not_asked: model qualification is not established ({status}); held from its DATA, the model is not asked
ask_capped_over: the model says this may break the rule: P(fail) {p} is at or over {t_fail}; it never fails a unit on its own
ask_not_usable: the model is not calibrated as usable on this rule ({status})
ask_bad_bounds: calibration bounds are missing or invalid
ask_between: P(fail) {p} is between the calibrated {t_pass} and {t_fail}

no_applicable_rule.says: No declared rule applies to this unit; it is unqualified, not passed.

uncertain_only.says: These rules can flag uncertainty but cannot establish a pass.

context_review.finding_why: Rule applicability to this source or instruction context needs qualified review.
context_review.says: This unit needs context-specific review. Do not rewrite preserved source words from a word finding.

refused.rules: rules is a non-empty list of rule rows: the rules the units are checked against.
refused.units: units is a non-empty list of { text, kind } (or { view, kind } for a JSON artifact): the things to check.
refused.verdict_rules: verdict_rules is the person's rule document: { rows, fold, stage: { default }, stance_rule, novel: { rule, says }, agree_clears: { rules } }. Missing: {missing}.
refused.pairs: A reading row's pairs[].rejected names a stand that is not a current exact stand on a text: {missing}. Pass that stand, or take the pair out of the row.
